name: scale_p43
description: Scaling with the number of agents: 1-LV-rural3--2-sw with 43 of its 43 prosumer buses as participants (scale_p13, _p26, _p43 on the same network; the rest as background), the market and PPO defaults of market_s3, 192k environment steps (where market_s3's runs were near their plateau), DTDE. CTDE is scale_p43_ctde (about 10 environment steps per second with 43 critics on the global state: too slow for the 4 h of blackwell1), CTCE scale_p43_ctce.
